_comment: Post-deploy smoke targets for the affiliate network. Each entry is checked
against LIVE production by smoke.mjs. `expectedCards` is the number of
rendered product cards on that canary roundup (data-rig-product-card roots),
verified against prod — if it drops (e.g. the MDC multi-card render bug
regresses, collapsing a roundup to one card), the smoke job goes red.
Pick the biggest roundup per site so a partial-render regression is unmissable.

`deepPath` (or canaryPath) is sampled for a SECOND canonical check. The homepage canonical is the least likely to be wrong: on 2026-08-02 QuizSort's homepage canonical was correct while all 1277 others named a URL that redirected, so a homepage-only check reported clean throughout.
